corpus_coverage.coverage_summary: Caelestis already distinguishes utility-access systems, usage capacity, provisioning, depletion, restriction, fallback, rollback and remediation; provides access-state arbitration; and contains adjacent security, operations and sovereign-assurance controls. It does not yet expressly require valid purchased, licensed, installed, downloaded, subscription-entitled or physically possessed content to remain usable through a proportionate cached, signed, local, grace-period or degraded pathway when remote verification infrastructure is unavailable.
remaining_gaps: Distinguish valid entitlement from inability to verify, account suspension, authentication failure, service outage and revocation.
Require proportionate cached, signed, local, grace-period or degraded verification for offline-capable content.
Define bounded fraud, security, legal and safety exceptions.
Require accurate outage-state representation and remediation where valid access is denied.
Address centralised cross-jurisdiction dependency through sovereign-assurance review.

failure_classification.severity_assessment_basis: S2: The evidenced pathway supports substantial harm through loss of practical access to purchased content, loss of access to installed or downloaded content, physical-media dependence on remote licence verification within vendor-specific incident demonstrating a cross-platform architectural pattern, without establishing severe widespread or catastrophic impact.
failure_classification.visibility: user-visible through sign-in, library, launch, licence-verification and store failures

preserved_analysis.failure_mode_definition: A failure mode in which a user possesses a facially valid entitlement to digital or physically possessed content, but access is contingent on the real-time availability of a remote identity, licence, subscription, storefront, publisher or platform-verification service. When that service is unavailable, the system denies use without a proportionate continuity mechanism and without evidence that the entitlement itself is expired, suspended, revoked, fraudulent or otherwise invalid.
preserved_analysis.failure_threshold: The threshold is met where: (1) a valid purchased, licensed, installed, downloaded, subscription-entitled or physically possessed content interest exists; (2) a remote verification or identity dependency becomes unavailable; (3) the user is denied practical access because verification cannot complete; and (4) no proportionate cached entitlement, signed offline credential, grace period, local verification or degraded operating pathway is available. A temporary outage does not meet the threshold where the affected function is inherently online-only and no purchased offline-capable content interest is impaired.
